shortDescription: Manage multiple pfSense firewall aliases, rules, and rule separators, plus interfaces and VLANs

options.name: aggregated_aliases
options.description: Dict of aliases to apply on the target

options.name: aggregated_interfaces
options.description: Dict of interfaces to apply on the target

options.name: aggregated_nat_outbounds
options.description: Dict of nat_outbound rules to apply on the target

options.name: aggregated_nat_port_forwards
options.description: Dict of nat_port_forward rules to apply on the target

options.name: aggregated_rule_separators
options.description: Dict of rule separators to apply on the target

options.name: aggregated_rules
options.description: Dict of rules to apply on the target

options.name: aggregated_vlans
options.description: Dict of VLANs to apply on the target

options.name: ignored_aliases
options.description: aliases that will be ignored (won't be auto deleted)

options.name: ignored_rules
options.description: rules that will be ignored (won't be auto deleted)

options.name: interface_filter
options.description: only apply rules and rules separators on those interfaces (separated by space)

options.name: order_rules
options.description: rules will be generated following the playbook order

options.name: purge_aliases
options.description: delete all the aliases that are not defined into aggregated_aliases

options.name: purge_interfaces
options.description: delete all the interfaces that are not defined into aggregated_interfaces

options.name: purge_nat_outbounds
options.description: delete all the nat_outbound rules that are not defined into aggregated_nat_outbounds

options.name: purge_nat_port_forwards
options.description: delete all the nat_port_forward rules that are not defined into aggregated_nat_port_forwards

options.name: purge_rule_separators
options.description: delete all the rule separators that are not defined into aggregated_rule_separators

options.name: purge_rules
options.description: delete all the rules that are not defined into aggregated_rules

options.name: purge_vlans
options.description: delete all the VLANs that are not defined into aggregated_vlans
